posts.hook: Anthropic's top models got cheaper and now claim a proof of Fermat
posts.caption: anthropic launched fable 5.2 and mythos 5.2 at 20% lower prices, an openssh and musl flaw is under active attack, and the nvidia story picked up an fbi angle. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at ==20% lower prices==
slides.desc: Top-tier agent work gets cheaper; Mythos stays limited to vetted cyber and life-science orgs.

slides.title: Anthropic says about 1,000 Fable agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean
slides.desc: A vendor claim, but it shows what long-running agent teams are now pointed at.

terms.gloss: a proof assistant that checks mathematical proofs by computer

slides.title: Meta answers with Muse Ember, a small model priced for agents
slides.desc: Meta claims more intelligence per dollar than Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna.

slides.title: The OpenSSH and musl flaw *sshole is under active attack
slides.desc: GreyNoise saw intrusions four days after disclosure; check musl-based Linux hosts first.

terms.gloss: a small C library used by Alpine Linux and many embedded devices

slides.title: Trump says the FBI is looking into Jensen Huang's affair
slides.desc: The Nvidia story now spans an FBI angle, a May short report and chip undercounts.

posts.hook: Anthropic put a price on itself: up to $1.4 trillion
posts.caption: anthropic opened its ipo roadshow at $70 to $78 a share, google released gemini 4 carbon to paying developers, and deepmind says its agents verified signal's core encryption. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO roadshow opens at ==$70 to $78 a share==
slides.desc: 825M shares on Nasdaq as ANT; the implied $1.4 trillion is below the $2 trillion once expected.

slides.title: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to paid API and AI Ultra users
slides.desc: Its top model leaves a two-week cyber-defender pilot, a day after Anthropic's launch.

slides.title: DeepMind says agents wrote ==three million lines== of Lean to verify Signal's encryption
slides.desc: Machine-checked proofs of shipping software were too slow to attempt at this size.

terms.gloss: a proof assistant that checks mathematical proofs by computer

slides.title: Claude gets Sheets, Whiteboards and data dashboards
slides.desc: Anthropic steps out of the coding niche into the office software Microsoft owns.

slides.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 did real work in Mercedes-Benz factories
slides.desc: DeepMind's robot model ships with an open safety benchmark, ASIMOV-jailbreak.

slides.title: SoftBank wrote off $3.7B in data center equipment advances
slides.desc: The AI buildout continues, but the first large prepayments are being abandoned.
